title: Stable Promo Code Checkout and Navigation
user_story: As a returning customer, I want promo codes to apply without errors and search results to be accurate so that I can complete my order smoothly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid promo code, when the customer applies it at checkout, then the discount is shown before payment.
Given a valid search query, when the customer submits it, then relevant results are displayed.
Given a valid promo code, when the customer completes payment, then the charged amount matches the discounted total.
Given a valid search query, when the customer clicks on a result, then the corresponding order details are displayed.
assumptions: Promo codes are single-use per order.
open_questions: Can promo codes be combined with loyalty rewards?

title: Reliable Delivery Time Estimation
user_story: As a customer, I want the delivery time estimate to be accurate and reflect the actual delivery time so that I can plan my day accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delivery estimate of 30 minutes, when the customer receives a notification of delivery, then the delivery time is within 15 minutes of the estimated time.
Given a delivery estimate of 1 hour, when the customer receives a notification of delivery, then the delivery time is within 30 minutes of the estimated time.
Given a delivery estimate of 2 hours, when the customer receives a notification of delivery, then the delivery time is within 1 hour of the estimated time.
Given a delivery estimate, when the customer reports a delay, then the support team investigates and provides a revised delivery time estimate.
Given a delivery estimate, when the customer reports a missed delivery, then the support team sends a notification with a revised delivery time estimate and a new estimated delivery time.
assumptions: Delivery drivers are aware of their estimated delivery time and can provide updates to the app.
open_questions: What is the maximum acceptable delay for delivery estimates?
Can delivery drivers provide real-time updates on their location?
How will missed deliveries be handled in terms of refunds or replacements?

title: Error handling for payment failures
user_story: As a customer, I want the app to notify me of payment failures and offer a refund when I've been charged twice for the same order so that I can resolve the issue quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment fails, when the customer is notified, then an option to dispute the charge is presented.
Given a payment failure, when the customer disputes the charge, then a refund is processed within 24 hours.
Given a duplicate charge, when the customer contacts support, then a refund is issued immediately.
assumptions: Payment failures are typically due to insufficient funds or expired payment methods.
open_questions: What is the maximum timeframe for processing a refund after a payment failure?

title: Transparent pricing with clear fees
user_story: As a frequent user, I want the total cost of my order to include all applicable fees upfront so that I can budget accurately and avoid surprises.
acceptance_criteria: Given a menu item, when the customer views their order summary, then all applicable fees (delivery, service, tax) are clearly displayed.
Given a menu item, when the customer completes checkout, then the total cost (including fees) is displayed before final payment.
Given a menu item, when the customer reviews their order history, then the total cost (including fees) for each order is visible.
Given a menu item, when the customer requests a refund, then the refund amount (after fees) is processed correctly.
assumptions: Menu items have a fixed price and no additional charges.
open_questions: Are there any discounts or promotions that could affect the total cost?
